home.change_my_plan_sub: Redo the intake if your goal, equipment, or schedule shifted.

log.title: Log
log.cta_plate_sub: Snap your meal. Honest ranges, logged to today.
log.cta_menu_sub: We rank dishes against your remaining budget.
log.cta_manual_sub: Foods you know cold — name, kcal, macros.
log.recent_sub: One tap to re-log something you eat often.
log.empty_body: Tap one of the buttons above to add your first meal.

progress.title: Progress
progress.sub: Trend over weeks, not any single day.
progress.log_weighin_sub: The trend re-tunes your targets automatically as you log.
progress.body_scan_sub: Honest body-fat range + weeks-to-goal. Photo not stored.
progress.calendar_sub: Every meal, workout, weigh-in, and water log in a month view.

coach.title: Coach
coach.sub: Knows your goals + macros. Ask anything.
coach.empty_body: What's a good pre-workout meal? Is shawarma OK tonight? How do I train around a knee issue? I know your profile — I'll factor it in.

fasting.active_sub: The timer updates live. End it when you eat.
fasting.idle_sub: Pick a protocol. We track the window and log completion.
fasting.end_confirm_body: This will stop the timer and record the duration.

workout.notes_placeholder: How did it feel? Any tweaks?
workout.at_least_one_set_err: Log at least one set on one exercise.
workout.swap_no_options: No substitutes listed for this exercise.

manual_meal.title: Add without scanning.
manual_meal.sub: For foods you know cold. Only name + kcal are required — macros stay as a single value (no ranges) since you're providing them yourself.

common.permission_denied_body: Enable access in Settings to scan.

plate.title: What did you eat?
plate.sub: Snap a photo of your meal. Honest ranges for calories and macros — not point values.
plate.what_we_see_hint: Uncheck anything you didn't eat. Ranges are honest; high end is the cap.
plate.pick_at_least_one_err: Pick at least one item to log.
plate.edit_portion_grams_body: Currently ~{{g}}g. Enter actual weight in grams.
plate.edit_portion_multiplier_body: Enter a multiplier (e.g. 0.5 for half, 1.5 for 50% more).

menu.title: What should you order?
menu.sub: Photograph the menu. SE7A reads it, checks what you have left for today, and ranks dishes by fit.
menu.restaurant_prompt_body: Used to remember dishes across visits. Case doesn't matter.
menu.past_dishes_sub: Tap any dish you had before to log it again.

body.title: An honest read.
body.sub: A photo can't beat a DEXA scan — we won't pretend it can. You get a body-fat range and an estimate of weeks to your goal at your current pace.
body.privacy_text: Your photo is processed in memory and discarded after analysis. We do not store body-composition photos.
body.advice: Tight-fitting clothing, neutral lighting, full-body frame. Loose shirts hide the waist and widen the range.
body.reading_sub: The photo will be discarded after this call.
body.reality_check_body: A photo can't beat hydrostatic weighing or a DEXA scan. The honest range above accounts for what we can't see. Use the trend over weeks, not any single estimate, as your signal.
body.in_target_body: Your estimate overlaps your target ({{low}}–{{high}}%). Holding here is the work.
body.below_target_body: You're leaner than the band for your goal. Consider switching to maintain or bulk.
body.not_applicable_body: Your current goal doesn't involve fat loss.
body.weeks_body: At your current goal rate, to reach the top of your target band ({{pct}}%). Assumes loss is mostly fat — real life is messier.

login.sub: We'll email you a one-tap link. No password to remember.
login.sent_msg: Check {{email}} — tap the link to sign in.
login.invalid_email: That doesn't look like an email.

callback.no_user: Sign-in succeeded but no user — try again.

onboarding.welcome_body_new: Eleven quick questions. We compute your calorie + macro targets and pick a workout plan that fits your week.
onboarding.welcome_body_returning: Your current answers are prefilled — just change what's different and tap through the rest.
onboarding.welcome_footnote_new: ~90 seconds. You can change any of it any time.
onboarding.welcome_footnote_returning: Fast — usually 20 seconds if not much has changed.
onboarding.couldnt_compute: Couldn't compute your plan — try again.
onboarding.couldnt_save_plan: Couldn't save your plan — try again.

sex.title: What's your sex assigned at birth?
sex.hint: Used only for BMR math — SE7A doesn't care about identity here, it cares about metabolic rate.

birthdate.title: Your birthdate?
birthdate.hint: Metabolism shifts with age. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. You must be 16+.

size.title: Height and weight.
size.hint: In centimeters and kilograms. Whatever the scale says today — we'll recalibrate as it changes.

activity.title: How active are you day-to-day?
activity.hint: Not counting workouts. Just your regular life — desk vs on-feet vs manual labor.
activity.moderate_sub: On feet most of the day

goal.title: What are we chasing?
goal.hint: You can change this any time. Body composition shifts happen over months, not weeks.

rate.title: How fast?
rate.hint: Aggressive rates work short-term. Sustainable rates work long-term. Negative = losing, positive = gaining.
rate.desc_slow: Slow {{dir}}. Easiest to sustain, minimal muscle risk / minimal fat gain.
rate.desc_standard: Standard rate. Recommended for most people.
rate.desc_aggressive: Aggressive. Works short-term; harder to sustain past 8 weeks.
rate.desc_very_fast: Very fast. Only appropriate for short cuts with lots of fat to lose. Not recommended long-term.

experience.title: How much lifting experience?
experience.hint: Be honest — if you overestimate, we'll prescribe volume that grinds you down. Underestimate is easier to correct.
experience.beginner_sub: Less than a year of consistent training

equipment.title: What do you have access to?
equipment.hint: Programs are picked to match. Home + gym works for a lot of people.
equipment.bodyweight_sub: You + gravity + maybe a pull-up bar

days.title: Days per week you can realistically commit?
days.hint: Consistency > intensity. A 3-day plan you actually do beats a 6-day plan you don't.

rest_day.title: Rest days different?
rest_day.hint: On days without a workout, eat less. Common for cutting — helps you land the weekly deficit without under-eating on training days. Skip if you'd rather keep it simple.

injuries.title: Anything to work around?
injuries.hint: Comma-separated. Examples: lower back, right shoulder, knees. Leave blank if nothing.

reveal.title: Here's where we start.
reveal.sub: Based on your goal ({{goal}}), experience, equipment, and days per week. You can switch plans any time from your dashboard.

insights.title: Patterns SE7A noticed
insights.sub: Last {{days}} days of your data — no AI, just math.
insights.empty: Nothing to surface yet. Two or three weeks of consistent logging usually turns up something.

voice_log.title: Say what you ate
voice_log.empty_items: We didn't catch any items — try again.
voice_log.permission_needed_body: Open Settings → SE7A to enable microphone access.

language.title: Language
language.description: SE7A supports Arabic and English. Pick whichever fits.
language.restart_body: Close SE7A and reopen it to see right-to-left layout changes.
